hits.title: Low Moments, Small Balls and Star Discrepancy
hits.abstract_snippet: Let $D_P$ be the discrepancy function of a configuration $P$ of $N$ points in the $d$-dimensional unit cube, and let $\|D_P\|_q$ be its $L^q$ discrepancy. hits.title: Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems
hits.abstract_snippet: When a capable model and a human reviewer cooperate on the same decision, which human still adds value? hits.title: Batch-Dynamic Coreness and Applications with Logarithmic Work via Balanced Pressures
hits.abstract_snippet: We give a parallel algorithm that maintains a one-sided $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximation of all core numbers under batches of edge insertions and deletions. For fixed $\varepsilon>0$, the expected amortized work is $O(\log n)$ per edge update, and each batch has deterministic polylogarithmic depth.
